captions.detailed: A minimalist, matte-black bedside wall-arm task lamp. It features a rectangular wall mounting plate, a short square-profile base arm, and a longer square-profile outer arm. The light source is a cylindrical spotlight head mounted within a U-shaped yoke. The base arm pivots horizontally at the wall plate, the outer arm rotates relative to the base arm at an elbow hinge, and the spotlight head tilts vertically inside its yoke.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a matte-black wall-mounted task lamp. The design should feature a rectangular wall plate, a short square-section base link, a longer square-section outer arm connected via a hinge joint, and a cylindrical spotlight head that tilts vertically within a U-shaped yoke at the end of the arm.
captions.factory: Construct a rectangular wall plate using a thin box primitive. Extrude a short square-profile base arm from a central bracket, adding a hinge block. Create an elbow hinge joint connecting the base arm to a longer square-profile outer arm. At the end of the outer arm, model a U-shaped yoke using combined box elements, and mount a hollowed-out cylinder representing the spotlight head between the yoke arms with a horizontal tilt axis.
